statement: For the degree-three member with all eight point constraints real and generic, the maximum number of real rational cubic curves is 12, and it is attained.

answer.text: For the degree-three member with all eight point constraints real and generic, the maximum number of real rational cubic curves is 12, and it is attained.
answer.qualification: This determines only the degree-three member with all eight constraints real; no claim for other degrees or mixed conjugate data is made.

source.location: Proposition 4.7.3 and preceding “Digression: real rational curves”, printed p.50

scope: Degree d=3 in the rational-plane-curve family, with eight generic real point constraints.
notes: The extracted result covers only d=3 and all-real constraints; it does not determine the minimum or maximum in every degree or for mixed conjugate data.
